settings.heading: Help & FAQ
settings.body: Delivery, payment, returns, sizing and authenticity — the short answers, in plain language. Still stuck? Message us.

settings.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.answer: Inside Dhaka: 24 to 48 hours. Rest of Bangladesh: 2 to 4 working days. Orders placed before 4pm are dispatched the same day.

settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer: Free on orders over ৳2,000. Below that it is ৳60 inside Dhaka and ৳120 elsewhere in Bangladesh.

settings.question: Can I track my parcel?
settings.answer: Yes. You get an SMS with the courier's tracking number and phone number as soon as the parcel leaves our hands.

settings.question: Can I ask for delivery on a specific date?
settings.answer: Add the date to your order notes at checkout. For birthdays, anniversaries and Eid we hold the parcel and time it so it lands that morning.

settings.question: Do you deliver outside Bangladesh?
settings.answer: Not yet. We ship to all 64 districts inside Bangladesh only. International shipping is on the list for next year.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: Cash on delivery anywhere in Bangladesh, plus bKash, Nagad, Rocket, and Visa / Mastercard / American Express at checkout.

settings.question: Is cash on delivery available everywhere?
settings.answer: Yes, all 64 districts. For orders over ৳10,000 we ask for a small advance to cover the courier, refunded into the order total.

settings.question: Is it safe to pay by card here?
settings.answer: Card and mobile payments run through Shopify's encrypted checkout. We never see or store your card number.

settings.question: Do prices include VAT?
settings.answer: Yes. Every price on the site is the final price. Nothing is added at checkout except delivery, where it applies.

settings.question: What is your return window?
settings.answer: 7 days from the day it is delivered. The item has to be unused and back in its original box with the tags on.

settings.question: Who pays for the return courier?
settings.answer: We do, if the item is faulty, damaged or not what you ordered. If you simply changed your mind, it is ৳100 deducted from the refund.

settings.question: Can I exchange a ring for a different size?
settings.answer: Yes, and the first size exchange is free. Message us on WhatsApp with your order number and the size you need.

settings.question: Can beauty products be returned?
settings.answer: Only unopened and with the seal intact. For hygiene reasons we cannot take back anything that has been used.

settings.question: How long does a refund take?
settings.answer: Two to five working days once the item reaches us and passes the check. bKash and Nagad refunds are usually same day.

settings.question: How do I find my ring size?
settings.answer: Wrap a strip of paper around the base of the finger, mark where it meets, and measure the length in millimetres. 52mm is a UK L, 54mm a UK N, 57mm a UK P. If you are between sizes, go up.

settings.question: Are the watches water resistant?
settings.answer: Most are 3ATM — fine in rain and hand-washing, not for swimming or showers. Anything rated 5ATM or above is listed as such on the product page.

settings.question: Are your sunglasses really polarised?
settings.answer: The ones labelled polarised are, and they carry UV400 protection. Hold two pairs at 90 degrees to each other — if the overlap goes black, they are genuine.

settings.question: Is the leather real?
settings.answer: Where a product says full-grain or genuine leather, it is. Where we use vegan leather we say vegan leather. We do not blur the two.

settings.question: What warranty do I get?
settings.answer: 12 months on watch movements, 6 months on everything else against manufacturing faults. Wear and tear, water damage and accidental damage are not covered.

settings.title: Contact form
settings.text: Prefer to write it out? Use the contact form and we will come back to you.
